en: Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a straight city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A small group of uniformed soldiers and a drummer walk down the center of the street, with a church tower visible in the distance. On the right side, a hanging sign advertises a guest garden and bowling alley. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street in Graz, named Lazarethgasse.
